title: Framework SQL built from input (eloquent) — review required
description: A eloquent data call assembles SQL from parts: whereRaw("a = $b"). Framework helpers do not sanitize interpolated values. This lexical rule flags the assembly; the reviewer confirms every part is trusted or parameterizes it.
remediation: Use the framework's binding (parameter bindings); never interpolate values.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any assembled query matches, including trusted ones.
